activeSlice.scope: Add an explicitly gated disposable persisted real-public Brand anchor for HI2 shadow evidence when no existing persisted Brand is Hunter-ready. The fixture is created in the single unambiguous existing workspace, populated only with source-backed inferred Brand Brain fields through normal audited services, used read-only for paired evidence, and deleted in finally. Existing user Brands are not modified.
successCriteria: Disposable persisted anchor is allowed only when zero existing persisted Hunter-ready Brands are available and an explicit runtime flag is true.
At least one existing persisted Brand must identify the target tenant, and all candidate persisted Brands must belong to one unambiguous workspace before any fixture write occurs.
The disposable anchor represents the real public Vercel Brand and uses official public About and Acceptable Use Policy evidence.
Brand Brain bootstrap writes only normal audited source-backed inferred fields; it never writes owner-confirmed fields or modifies existing user Brands.
The disposable anchor must pass the unchanged canonical Hunter-ready gate before entering the evidence cohort.
The disposable Brand is deleted in a finally path after evidence completion or failure.
The evidence cohort remains at least 3 distinct real Brands and 30 paired V1/V2 runs.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no canary or production enablement is introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
